name: Stanford Bunny
conversion: Remove 1113 unreferenced vertices and confidence/intensity scan fields.
Center referenced bounds and uniformly scale the longest axis to 1.6. Preserve all triangles and winding.
Generate area-weighted smooth normals; use a uniform material with zero UVs.
Cook patch hierarchy and meshlets with builder 2 default settings; share identical vertex attributes across LODs, byte-shuffle section fields and losslessly compress with GZip SmallestSize.
